title: Constructible representatives of restricted cohomology classes
statement: Let X and X₀ be quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], i:X₀→X any morphism, Λ a finite commutative ring, F a sheaf of Λ-modules on X [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and q≥0. Every c∈H^q(X₀,i⁻¹F) equals H^q(i⁻¹a)(z), for some constructible module sheaf G [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], morphism a:G→F and class z∈H^q(X₀,i⁻¹G). All cohomology is underlying abelian sheaf cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology].

proof.text: Apply AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.exists_filtered_colimit_constructible to F and obtain the small filtered category A, diagram D, constructibility witnesses hD, cocone ι and its colimit witness hι.
Apply exists_restriction_class_of_filtered_presentation to ι, hι, q and c. Obtain a stage a, class z and the exact equality for the restricted underlying abelian cohomology map.
Take G = D.obj a and the map ι.app a. The stored witness hD a proves constructibility; the equality from the preceding step proves the cohomology clause.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03SA(3) and 03Q5: filtered constructible presentation followed by extraction at a stage; second reading by F1
